title: PRIVATE Guided Mangrove Eco-Tour Adventure
includes: Single Kayak, Tandem Kayak or Paddleboard
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Paddle through the serene waters of Geiger Key at your own pace, with a private guided kayak/Paddleboard tour that immerses you in the natural beauty of the Florida Keys. Paddle through tranquil mangroves where your expert guide highlights local wildlife and ecological wonders, from tropical bird habitats to vibrant sea turtles. This eco-friendly adventure is suitable for all skill levels, ensuring a relaxing time as you navigate the peaceful waterways. Discover hidden gems and soak in the lush surroundings, all while enjoying small group sizes for a personalized experience.
